_note: The canonical roster of the learner's interests. Every lesson must be written through at least three of these — the checker enforces it. Add to this file rather than remembering things in your head. Each entry carries hooks: concrete, factual angles that connect a curriculum topic to the interest without being decorative.

learner.name: Grade 6, age ~12
learner.notes: ADHD. Bright, not a weak reader. Interest-driven attention. Trains daily. Never talk down — simplify the sentence, not the idea.

cars.label: Car mode
hooks: Crumple zones and safety cells — structures designed to deform vs structures designed to stay rigid
Seatbelt load paths — force routed onto bone, away from soft tissue
Forza livery editor — mirror, duplicate and rotate are literally the three transformations
Power-to-weight ratio — a stat he already reads, applicable to materials and biology
Honeycomb crash structure — hexagons for stiffness per gram
Suspension absorbing a landing — deformation as energy management
Trains: rails as a fixed track, couplings, braking distance, load distribution over bogies
Tyre tread and carbon weave as repeating patterns
Engine firing frequency = rpm x cylinders / 120. At 3000 rpm a four fires at 100 Hz, a V6 at 150, a V8 at 200
So at the same revs I4 : V6 : V8 = 4 : 6 : 8 = 2 : 3 : 4 — an octave, a fifth and a fourth. Real ratio work
Double the revs and the note goes up exactly one octave, because you doubled the frequency
Crossplane V8 (muscle car) burbles because its banks fire unevenly; flatplane V8 (Ferrari) fires evenly and wails higher
A bigger, slower engine is a lower note. Pitch is just how often something repeats

boxing.label: Boxing mode
hooks: The kinetic chain — power starts at the floor, the fist only delivers it
Boxer's fracture as a technique problem, not a strength problem
Hand wraps compressing 27 bones into one block
Chin tuck and rotational forces on the brain
Antagonistic muscle pairs — why 'stay loose' is mechanics, not mindset
Trained athletes sweat sooner — adaptation, not weakness
Meal timing around sessions, and blood flow competition
Filipino athletes: Manny Pacquiao, Hidilyn Diaz

gaming.label: Game mode
hooks: Death Stranding — equippable exoskeletons; load-bearing, balance and centre of gravity as core mechanics; cargo weight vs stamina
Cyberpunk 2077 — the Skeleton cyberware slot; titanium bone lacing; subdermal armour sitting below the dermis
Pacific Drive — armour the panels that keep getting wrecked, which is Wolff's Law as a game loop; fuel carried vs fuel burned
Minecraft — cubes tessellating 3D space; crafting as chemical combination; redstone as circuits
Forza — livery transformations, tuning as system trade-offs
Tilesets and hex grids — why game worlds are built on shapes that tessellate
Upgrade trees and stats as a model for adaptation over time
Terrain tiles translate rather than rotate, because it is computationally cheaper
Solar Smash — he fires weapons and meteors at planets. Mass and speed as inputs, damage as output
Minecraft axolotls: real ones are neotenic, regrow limbs, and are critically endangered in Lake Xochimilco

growth.label: Your body right now
hooks: The bone-density window closing around 18–20
Growth hormone released in deep sleep and after hard training
Wolff's Law — bone reinforces where it is loaded
Muscle is built during recovery, not during the session
Puberty hormones driving sebum production, and what acne actually is
Consequences framing — osteoporosis, sarcopenia, fragility fractures
Always connect to a decision he controls this week

space.label: Space mode
hooks: Astronauts lose 1–2% bone density per month — Wolff's Law running backwards
Scale comparisons — distances, sizes, orders of magnitude
Why the Moon has no weather and Earth does
Gravity as a load, and what happens when you remove it
Light taking time to arrive — looking at a star is looking at the past

story.label: Story mode
hooks: He writes adventure stories where someone drives into a strange scenario and faces aliens or Slenderman
Don Quixote — a man who decided to become the main character; Chapter 1 is a character-creation screen
Naming things as a way of making them real
Structure of an adventure: setup, gear, companion, the road
Wordplay and absurd comparisons land well — one dry joke per section, no more
Unreliable perception — a windmill seen as a giant
Creepypasta — uncanny rather than gory. The dread comes from something being almost right
The unreliable narrator is the engine of every creepypasta, and of Don Quixote

disasters.label: Disaster mode
hooks: Magnitude is not linear: one step is 10x the shaking and about 32x the energy. Two steps is 1000x the energy
The Philippines sits on the Ring of Fire and takes about 20 tropical cyclones a year, 8 or 9 making landfall
Typhoon Haiyan (Yolanda), November 2013: winds around 315 km/h and a storm surge up to about 7 m in Tacloban
1990 Luzon earthquake: magnitude 7.7, about 1,600 dead. 2013 Bohol: magnitude 7.2
Meteor energy is half m v squared. Double the mass and energy doubles; double the speed and it quadruples
Chelyabinsk 2013: a rock about 20 m across, entering near 19 km/s, injured around 1,500 people mostly by broken glass
Tunguska 1908: an object maybe 50-60 m across flattened roughly 2,000 square km of forest without leaving a crater

aviation.label: Black box mode
hooks: The black box is two recorders and it is painted bright orange, so searchers can see it
Almost no crash has one cause. It is a chain, and removing any one link stops it
United 232, 1989: all three hydraulic systems severed, the crew steered on engine thrust alone; 185 of 296 lived
Tenerife 1977, the worst accident: two radio calls overlapped. It is why pilot phrasing is standardised now
Flying is the safest way to travel per kilometre precisely because every crash is investigated and published

memes.label: Meme mode
hooks: Back In My Day is hyperbole with a straight face: uphill both ways, 300 miles, one shoe. Great for tense and for exaggeration
Storm Area 51, September 2019: about 2 million people clicked going and roughly 150 turned up. A ratio joke that writes itself
The comedy is in the mismatch between the claim and the reality. That is a real rhetorical device, not just a joke

physics.label: Physics mode
hooks: The square law is everywhere: energy, wind force, wing lift and braking distance all go as speed squared
Double the speed and all four quadruple. Double the mass and energy only doubles — mass is proportional, speed is not
Pressure is force spread over area. Same force, smaller area, more damage
Water is about 800 times denser than air, which is why a storm surge does what wind cannot
A wing works by throwing air downward; the air pushes back. Not the equal-transit-time story, which is wrong
At 35,000 ft the air is about a quarter of sea-level pressure — too little to push oxygen into your blood

rules: Every lesson uses at least three different lenses. The checker enforces this.
A lens card must teach the curriculum content, not just mention the interest. If you delete the game reference and the card still teaches something, it is a good lens card.
Prefer a hook that is structurally true over one that is merely thematic. Death Stranding's exoskeletons genuinely are exoskeletons.
Rotate the lenses across a lesson. Four car cards in a row is worse than one of each.
Never invent a fact about a game or sport to make a hook work. If it is not true, find another hook.
Vary the lens. Boxing every time is as generic as no lens at all.
Where a sentence has to be invented anyway, make it carry a consequence he would recognise: he did not train, so he lost.
Two angles on a hard idea beat one. Add a second lens where the concept is abstract, not where it is already easy.
